rows.relevanceGate: Says so when the answer is not in the documents

buy.a: No. The app has no payments, no accounts and no hosted service, and this page has no checkout. The prices are a preview.

free.a: Yes. hybrid-rag is open source under the MIT licence and runs on your computer, so there is nothing to pay and no time limit. Your hardware and electricity are the cost. If you choose the Claude API for answers (LLM_PROVIDER=anthropic), Anthropic bills the API key you provide.

hosted.a: They are an idea, not a promise. A hosted service is not built, there is no date, and the prices, limits and names may change or be dropped.

follow.q: How would I find out if that changes?
follow.a: There is no sign-up and no mailing list here. Any change would show up in the <repo>repository on GitHub</repo>.
